title: LocalStrongAiming.lean

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a differentiable function on a finite-dimensional real inner-product space. Convexity is not required, and negative curvature is permitted. The global minimizer set M is nonempty and need not be a singleton.

problem_class.label: pl
problem_class.details: The nearest-minimizer strong aiming inequality implies the local PL inequality ‖∇f(x)‖² ≥ 2μ(f(x)−f*) whenever dist(x,M)<r. No global PL condition is imposed.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Every oracle answer is an exact gradient at the queried point, for every call index and seed. There is no oracle error or sampling dependence to control. Each execution step counts one gradient call.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/LocalStrongAiming.lean: spec.admissible, HasGradientAt oracle condition; LongTails/Template.lean: _run and execute.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a complete, finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its induced norm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: On U={x:dist(x,M)<r}, the gradient is L-Lipschitz; f(y)≥f(x)+⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩−√(μL)‖y−x‖² for all x,y∈U; and f(x)−f*+(μ/2)‖x−z‖²≤⟨∇f(x),x−z⟩ for every nearest minimizer z. No uniqueness, affine geometry, or smoothness of the minimizer projection is assumed. Initialization satisfies dist(x0,M)<r and f(x0)−f*≤Δ, with 0<μ≤L, r>0, Δ≥0, 256Δ≤μr², and ε>0. E, L, μ, and x0 are public; r, Δ, and ε are hidden parameters.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/LocalStrongAiming.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, and spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The output point must satisfy f(output)−f(xstar)≤ε for a global minimizer xstar. No averaging or gradient-norm criterion is required.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee holds almost surely under the supplied output probability measure. Oracle cost is bounded by a fixed budget for every seed.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines local nearest-minimizer strong aiming, a condition-number-dependent weak convexity bound, and a quantitative initialization condition without imposing convexity or regular projection geometry.

descriptionHtml:
Nesterov under Local Strong Aiming

We consider minimizing a differentiable, possibly nonconvex function f:E→R on a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space E using Nesterov’s method. Around its nonempty minimizer set, f has an L-Lipschitz gradient, a quadratic lower model, and a strong aiming condition toward nearest minimizers, with 0<μ≤L. These conditions hold within distance r>0 of that set; the given starting point x0 lies there with objective gap at most μr2/256. The oracle returns ∇f(x) at x. For ε>0, the goal is a last iterate x¯ satisfying f(x¯)−f(x⋆)≤ε almost surely under P, the law of algorithm randomness, where x⋆ is a global minimizer.

The optimization problem is minx∈Ef(x). Write ⟨⋅,⋅⟩ for the inner product and ∥⋅∥ for its induced norm. For the minimizer set M, define d(x,M):=infz∈M∥x−z∥,Ur:={x∈E:d(x,M)<r}. The algorithm receives only E, L, μ, and x0; the radius r, initial gap bound Δ, and tolerance ε may enter the oracle-call budget but are not algorithm inputs.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Minimizers and initialization). There exists a global minimizer x⋆∈E. With M:={x∈E:f(x)=f(x⋆)}, the parameters and starting point satisfy 0<μ≤L,r>0,Δ≥0,ε>0,256Δ≤μr2,f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ,d(x0,M)<r.

Assumption 2 (Local regularity). The function f is Fréchet differentiable everywhere on E. For every x,y∈Ur, ∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥,f(y)≥f(x)+⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩−μL∥y−x∥2.

Assumption 3 (Local strong aiming). For every x∈Ur and every nearest minimizer z∈M, meaning ∥x−z∥=d(x,M), f(x)−f(x⋆)+μ2∥x−z∥2≤⟨∇f(x),x−z⟩.

The formulation is algorithm-specific: we analyze Nesterov’s method with position xk and velocity vk. Set s:=12L,q:=μs,v0:=0, with position initialized at the given x0. At each iteration k≥0, the method queries yk and updates according to yk=xk+svk,gk=∇f(yk),xk+1=xk+svk−s2gk,vk+1=1−q1+q(vk−sgk). Queries may be made at any point of E. After K≥0 oracle calls, the output is the last position x¯=xK. The required accuracy is f(x¯)−f(x⋆)≤εP-a.s.

comparisonHtml:
A differentiable function f on a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space attains f∗=f(x⋆); exact gradients are available. On Ur={x:d(x,M)<r}, ∇f is L-Lipschitz and f(y)≥f(x)+⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩−μL∥y−x∥2 for all x,y∈Ur. Strong aiming means ⟨∇f(x),x−z⟩≥f(x)−f∗+μ2∥x−z∥2 for every x∈Ur and every nearest z∈M. Assume 0<μ≤L, r>0, x0∈Ur, and 0≤f(x0)−f∗≤Δ≤μr2/256. Target: f(xK)−f(x⋆)≤ε, ε>0. Result (1) constructs fixed-parameter Nesterov with deterministic last-iterate accuracy; updates use L,μ, and the horizon uses Δ,ε.

Local acceleration under strong aiming: LocalStrongAiming.
Result Oracle complexity Novelty Limitations
(1) LocalStrongAimingNesterov (Ours) (⋆⋆⋆) (review) O(1+L/μlog⁡(1+Δ/ε)) gradient calls.
(2) Nesterov (Gupta and Wojtowytsch 2025, Thm. 11) O(1+L/μlog⁡(1+Δ/ε)) gradient calls. Affine M; global smoothness and strong aiming; weak-curvature coefficient at most μL/2. (1): Scope extends to curved, nonconvex M under tube assumptions. Matches the rate on the common affine, globally regular subclass. (1) needs local initialization; worse contraction constant (1/2 versus 1). Classes are not nested.
(3) Continuized Nesterov (Hermant et al. 2026, sec. 5.2), constant-probability guarantee Derived bound: O(1+L/μalog⁡(1+Δ/ε)) gradient calls for success probability 3/4. Global smoothness and strong aiming; convex M with C2 boundary; μ/L<ϕ−4. (1): Nonconvex curved M allowed; deterministic instead of constant-probability accuracy. Different guarantees preclude a like-for-like speedup claim. (1) needs weak convexity and local initialization; (3) is global without a weak-curvature bound. Classes are not nested.
(4) Nesterov (Feng and Yuan 2026, Thm. 2.2) No explicit call budget in (L,μ,Δ,ε). Local distance contraction approaches 1−2μ/3L+μ; basin and prefactor are implicit. Requires C2 and local PL. (1): Explicit nonasymptotic budget and basin Δ≤μr2/256; no C2 requirement. No comparable explicit cost bound in (4). (1) needs strong aiming and weak convexity beyond local PL; worse asymptotic contraction constant, with different error criteria.

Abbr: M=argminf; d(x,M)=infz∈M∥x−z∥; Δ is the initial objective-gap bound; L is the gradient Lipschitz constant; μ is the strong-aiming constant (the PL constant in (4)); ε is target objective accuracy; ϕ=(1+5)/2; a=1−ϕ(μ/L)1/4>0; PL means ∥∇f(x)∥2≥2μ(f(x)−f∗). Weak-curvature coefficient c denotes the coefficient of −∥y−x∥2 in the two-point lower bound.

Feng, Zixu, and Hao Yuan. 2026. Optimal Local Linear Convergence of Nesterov’s Accelerated Gradient Method for C2 Functions Under the Polyak–Łojasiewicz Inequality. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2603.21516.

import LongTails.Template
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real
import LongTails.Setups.SmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.FiniteDimension
import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.HausdorffDistance

namespace OracleTemplate.NearestAiming

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

noncomputable def nesterovStep (L μ : ℝ) (state : E × E) (g : E) : E × E :=
  let s := 1 / (2 * Real.sqrt L)
  let q := Real.sqrt μ * s
  (state.1 + s • state.2 - s ^ 2 • g,
    ((1 - q) / (1 + q)) • (state.2 - s • g))

end OracleTemplate.NearestAiming

open Set Metric
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.LocalStrongAiming

open OracleTemplate OracleTemplate.NearestAiming

structure Public extends toGradientPublic : LongTails.Setups.SmoothAndConvex.Public where
  [finiteE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  μ : ℝ

attribute [instance] Public.finiteE

structure Params extends Public where
  r : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

def FollowsNesterov (p : Public) (A : Algorithm p.E p.E p.E) : Prop :=
  ∃ position velocity : A.State → p.E,
    (∀ seed, position (A.initial seed) = p.x0 ∧ velocity (A.initial seed) = 0) ∧
    (∀ state, (A.query state).2 = position state + (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt p.L)) • velocity state) ∧
    (∀ state reply, (position (A.update state reply), velocity (A.update state reply)) =
      nesterovStep p.L p.μ (position state, velocity state) reply) ∧
    (∀ state, A.output state = position state)

abbrev CertifiedAlgorithm (p : Public) :=
  {A : Algorithm p.E p.E p.E // FollowsNesterov p A}

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Public
  Instance p := p.E → ℝ
  Query p := p.E
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput := Params.toPublic
  valid p := 0 < p.μ ∧ p.μ ≤ p.L ∧ 0 < p.r ∧ 0 ≤ p.Δ ∧
    256 * p.Δ ≤ p.μ * p.r ^ 2 ∧ 0 < p.ε
  admissible p f oracle :=
    (∀ k seed x, HasGradientAt f (oracle.answer k (0, x) seed) x) ∧
    (∀ x, HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) ∧
    (∃ xstar, IsMinOn f univ xstar ∧ f p.x0 - f xstar ≤ p.Δ ∧
      let M := {x | f x = f xstar}
      infDist p.x0 M < p.r ∧
      (∀ x y, infDist x M < p.r → infDist y M < p.r →
        ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ p.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
      (∀ x y, infDist x M < p.r → infDist y M < p.r →
        f x + ⟪gradient f x, y - x⟫ - Real.sqrt (p.μ * p.L) * ‖y - x‖ ^ 2 ≤ f y) ∧
      (∀ x z, infDist x M < p.r → z ∈ M → infDist x M = ‖x - z‖ →
        f x - f xstar + p.μ / 2 * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪gradient f x, x - z⟫))
  successful p f output P :=
    ∃ xstar, IsMinOn f univ xstar ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : MeasureTheory.Measure _), f (output ω) - f xstar ≤ p.ε
  allowedAlgorithm := FollowsNesterov

end LongTails.Setups.LocalStrongAiming
